audioService.loginRequired: Sign in to use the configured voice service.
audioService.serverHint: The service keeps generation jobs and billing reservations. Completed results recover into this project without being adopted automatically.
audioService.privatePlan: This is a private offline plan. It requires a new server review before execution.

flowEditor.title: JSON Flow editor
flowEditor.intro: Edit native nodes and connections. Saving keeps JSON sources and runs the same project compiler as Editor.
flowEditor.reloadHint: Reload discards the current draft. A conflict never replaces your draft automatically.
flowEditor.switchHint: Save or explicitly reload this draft before switching chapters.
flowEditor.graphHint: Dashed routes follow story order. Layout coordinates do not change execution order. Scroll to inspect larger graphs.
flowEditor.stableIdHint: Node and dialogue IDs stay stable when text or layout changes.
flowEditor.speaker: Stable speaker ID
flowEditor.branchHint: Conditional branches use choice conditions. Targets can address another chapter. An empty target is a draft and prevents saving.
flowEditor.aliasesHint: Use a JSON string or an array of strings; clear to use the default character.
flowEditor.audioHint: Music and ambience persist; sound effects play once. Choose native audio resources with the matching kind.
flowEditor.newChapterHint: Save the new chapter and native source declaration together, preserving the existing entry and project settings.

voiceDesigner.title: Voice design
voiceDesigner.intro: Design versioned voices for characters or the project narrator, audition candidates, then explicitly register, select and apply a profile.
voiceDesigner.speaker: Character / narrator
voiceDesigner.immutableHint: Saved intent and provider definitions are immutable. A successor gets a new identity and records its prior version.
voiceDesigner.label: Label
voiceDesigner.referenceHint: Import an authorized reference in Audio resources first. Consent must be a project-relative audit document; references are never treated as dialogue takes.
voiceDesigner.putDefinition: Use this definition in the draft
voiceDesigner.previewHint: Previews are temporary and unbound. Listening does not register a resource or select a dialogue take.
voiceDesigner.approveUnknownCost: I approve this preview with an unknown supplier price
voiceDesigner.unknownPrice: Supplier price is unknown; the character limit remains enforced.
voiceDesigner.replaceSelected: Explicitly replace the current sample selection
voiceDesigner.replaceBinding: Explicitly replace the current Profile provider binding
voiceDesigner.profileHint: Applying updates only the native character or narrator Profile. Existing dialogue takes remain historical and require separate binding.
voiceDesigner.unavailable: Connect and sign in to the managed voice service to design voices. Existing native Profiles remain editable.
voiceDesigner.unknownHint: The supplier outcome is unknown. Restore status or inspect it with the host; generation is never retried automatically.

voiceListening.dailyHint: Audition the current line and candidates with one player. Adoption never generates audio.
voiceListening.sameTextRequired: A/B requires the same line, locale, speaker and actual spoken text. Stale recordings can still be auditioned.
voiceListening.advancedHint: Choose 2–32 original recordings, anonymously shuffled as S01–S32 and grouped. Only a human supplies the six ratings; blanks remain pending. This is not a formal MOS study. Drafts stay private to this device and project and never change selected audio.
voiceListening.noReference: No verified generation-reference playback mapping is provided here. Choose N/A for reference consistency. Style fit can also be N/A without a reliable target.
voiceListening.historicalStyle: Stale recordings are included. The current style may have changed and is not evidence of their original generation target.
voiceListening.staleConfirm: This recording is stale. Confirm that you intend to adopt audio from the earlier text, dictionary or voice profile.
voiceListening.replaceConfirm: This replaces the current selected recording and retains history.
voiceListening.adoptConfirm: This recording will become the selected audio for this line.
voiceListening.confirmChecked: I auditioned the recording and reviewed the adoption and replacement scope
voiceListening.playRejected: Playback did not start. Use the player’s play button.
voiceListening.humanAttestation: I personally listened before providing these ratings
voiceListening.attestationHint: Complete the environment, at least 95% observed playback and the end of each sample, and every rating or N/A.
voiceListening.coverageHint: Use the same device, system volume and 1× speed. Seeking does not count as listening.
voiceListening.complete: Personal review confirmed; formal MOS is not calculated
voiceListening.pending: Pending human listening and ratings; formal MOS is not calculated
voiceListening.restored: Ratings restored as a draft. Playback evidence and human confirmation were cleared; listen again.
voiceListening.retainedAcknowledged: Reviewed and retained for this context. The recording remains stale; its generation identity is unchanged.
voiceListening.noStyle: No reliable style target is supplied; choose N/A.

voiceWorkflow.playSelected: Play selected voices in the game
voiceWorkflow.playHint: Start the game or choose the dialogue chapter. Only explicitly selected takes play; audition samples and unselected history stay in authoring.
voiceWorkflow.appliedVersion: {speaker} is bound to {voice} · version {version}. Review a dialogue generation plan next.
voiceWorkflow.legacyLibrary: Earlier voice-library entries are preserved below. Their audition selections do not bind dialogue. Create and explicitly apply a versioned design to continue.
voiceWorkflow.pendingSpeaker: Your current unsaved draft is preserved. Save to switch to {speaker}, or explicitly discard it.

musicWorkflow.busHint: Usage organizes creation; every musical use still plays through BGM operations on the music bus.
musicWorkflow.sourceUrlHint: Public HTTPS page without signed parameters. It is never a playback URL or automatically downloaded.
musicWorkflow.targetHint: These are creation targets. Audition the actual duration and loop seam; external tools do not guarantee them.
musicWorkflow.handoffHint: Compose your own music or copy the brief into a tool such as Suno. Export a local audio file, then import, audition, review and explicitly bind it to a chapter. This interface does not call a music generation API.
musicWorkflow.copyFailed: Could not copy. Download the brief instead.
musicWorkflow.invalid: Invalid music brief. Check the summary, numbers and public source page.
musicWorkflow.trackLegacy: Add creation and review metadata to legacy music
musicWorkflow.approveHint: Audition the local file and confirm its content and license. Approval verifies the actual bytes again and records review for this SHA.
musicWorkflow.confirmReview: I auditioned this file and confirm its license and intended use
musicWorkflow.legacyHint: Legacy BGM remains compatible. Edit metadata to add creation and review records.
musicWorkflow.assetMissing: This music asset is unavailable in the current project.
musicWorkflow.bindHint: Confirmation sets this BGM at the chapter entry. Later existing music cues still apply. Adjust loop, gain and fades in the audio node. Explicitly save the Flow JSON draft afterward.
musicWorkflow.reviewRequired: Audition and approve the current local file in the library before binding.
musicWorkflow.confirmBinding: I confirm this music as the selected chapter’s opening cue
musicWorkflow.mdHint: Review the native source below and explicitly save. Prose and dialogue line IDs remain intact; changes use conflict checks.
